request.description: Small pixel-art particle effect for a side-view horse race game, seen from the side: a turf divot kicked out by a galloping hoof. 2 or 3 small chunks of grass turf (green grass blades on top, dark brown soil underneath) and a few loose grass blades flip up and backwards to the LEFT in an arc, tumble and fall to the ground. 1 px darker outline. No smoke, no glow. 8 frames, canvas about 48x32 px, not looping, transparent background, crisp hard pixels, no anti-aliasing.
request.name: race-fx-divot

last_response.name: race-fx-divot
last_response.message: Made an 8-frame, 48×32 turf kick with three grass-topped soil chunks and four loose blades tumbling up and left, then falling to the ground. Crisp pixels, dark 1 px outlines, transparent background—no smoke or glow.
